response:
I checked the Statistics Canada tables on poverty by disability status. None of them break the rate down for Alberta, so I can't give you an Alberta figure.

Table 11-10-0090-01 (poverty and low-income statistics by disability status) covers Canada only. I didn't find a provincial table in the search, but I can't rule out one that the search missed.

**National figure, for comparison:** 12.6% of persons with disabilities aged 15 and over were in poverty in 2024. This uses the Market Basket Measure (2023 base) and covers all persons.
- Source: Statistics Canada, table 11-10-0090-01, vector v1793292452
- Reference period: 2024
- Earlier years: 12.9% in 2022 and 12.8% in 2023

I didn't pull the other low-income lines (such as the after-tax Low Income Measure) or the age and gender breakdowns.

For Alberta, you could request a custom tabulation from Statistics Canada's Canadian Income Survey. I haven't checked whether the Government of Alberta publishes its own figure.

I couldn't find an Alberta-specific poverty rate for people with disabilities. The only Statistics Canada table I found on this topic, 11-10-0090-01 (Poverty and low-income statistics by disability status), has a single geography, Canada. It has no provincial breakdown, and I didn't find any other table that does. I haven't estimated an Alberta figure.

**National figure, for reference:**
- 12.6% of Canadians aged 15 and over with disabilities were below the poverty line in 2024.
- This uses the Market Basket Measure (2023 base), the official poverty measure, and covers all persons aged 15+.
- It was 12.9% in 2022 and 12.8% in 2023.
- Source: Statistics Canada table 11-10-0090-01, vector v1793292452, reference period 2024.

The Canadian Income Survey, which feeds this table, may have Alberta data in a custom tabulation. Statistics Canada's Statistical Information Service could tell you whether that is available.

I couldn't find an Alberta poverty rate for people with disabilities, so I can't give you one.

- **Alberta:** Statistics Canada table 11-10-0090-01 ("Poverty and low-income statistics by disability status") has only a Canada-wide geography. Table 11-10-0093-01 has Alberta, but I found no disability category in it. I did not check its full list of demographic categories.
- **Canada:** The Market Basket Measure (2023 base) poverty rate for persons with disabilities aged 15 and over is **12.6%** in 2024. That is Canada-wide, not Alberta. Source: table 11-10-0090-01, vector v1793292452, reference period 2024. It covers all persons aged 15+ and uses the "all persons" family type, and I didn't pull the figure for people without disabilities.

For a provincial figure you would need a custom tabulation from Statistics Canada's Canadian Survey on Disability or the Canadian Income Survey. I have not verified whether one exists.
